gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE-AFTER EFFECTS - OKUSHA
Inguqulo 9.2.9  -  Okthoba 2026
================================================================================

AMATIMU E-ANIME amasha angu-33 ajoyina lawo e-Demon Slayer, imiphumela yegundane
yamatimu manje ibonakala ngempela ngaphakathi kwe-After Effects, futhi
uMkhethi wetimu manje uwuhlu olulodwa olwehlayo oluhlelekile.

NGAPHAMBI KOKUQALA
- Faka phezu kwenguqulo yakho yamanje usebenzisa isifaki sakho se-ZXP
  esejwayelekile, bese uqala kabusha i-After Effects kanye.
- Izilungiselelo zakho, itimu, ama-preset nama-expression owagcinile kuyagcinwa.

OKUSHA: AMATIMU E-ANIME ANGU-33
- Izilungiselelo ze-Flex > UMKHETHI WETIMU > ITIMU YEPHANELI manje inequembu
  elilodwa le-anime ngayinye: Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts),
  Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze),
  Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku),
  Frieren, Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika,
  Hisoka), Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100
  (Mob), My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) kanye ne-Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Umlingiswa ngamunye unokubukeka kwakhe: okulandela igundane lakho, ukuhlasela
  uma uchofoza inkinobho, okwenzekayo ngenkathi ubambe inkinobho yesokunxele,
  nokuqhuma ngemva kokubamba imizuzwana engaba ngu-2.5.
- Alula njengamatimu e-Demon Slayer: imiphumela iqhuba kuphela uma uhambisa
  igundane noma uchofoza. Vala IMIPHUMELA YENDAWO ukuze ugcine imibala kuphela.

OKUSHINTSHILE: UMKHETHI WETIMU
- Amakhadi e-Demon Slayer angaphansi kwe-ITIMU YEPHANELI asusiwe, ngakho
  Izilungiselelo ze-Flex sezimfushane. Khetha yonke itimu ohlwini olwehlayo
  lwe-ITIMU YEPHANELI; luvuleka kutimu oyisebenzisayo.
- I-Kurama ne-Baryon manje zikuqembu le-Naruto.

OKULUNGISIWE
- Imiphumela yegundane yamatimu (amanzi, amalangabi, umbani nokunye) kaningi
  yayingabonakali ngaphakathi kwe-After Effects, ngisho noma iModi Yokwenza Kahle
  ivaliwe. Izikhathi lapho iphanela ngokwayo yayimatasa, kanye nokuqala
  okumatasa, kwathathwa njengokuthi itimu iyaphuza, ngakho imiphumela yazivala
  yodwa. Manje, uma ikhadi lakho lezithombe (graphics card) liyidweba
  (kumakhompyutha amaningi), lezo zikhathi zenza nje imiphumela ibe lula
  isikhashana.

AKUSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisense, ukwenza kusebenze nazo zonke izixhumanisi kusebenza njengakuqala
  nje.
- Amatimu e-Demon Slayer angu-11 abukeka ncamashi njengaku-9.2.8.
- Wonke amanye amathebhu namathuluzi asebenza ncamashi njengoba kwakunjalo
  ku-9.2.8.
================================================================================

OKUSHINTSHILE: UMKHETHI WETIMU
- Amakhadi e-Demon Slayer angaphansi kwe-ITIMU YEPHANELI asusiwe, ngakho

  Manje, uma ikhadi lakho lezithombe (graphics card) liyidweba (kumakhompyutha

- Uma i-HLANGANISA UMLENZE ivaliwe kuZilungiselelo ze-Flex, imilayezo
  yokuqinisekisa yayingakwazi ukuvela nhlobo. Manje ihlala ivela.
- Uhlu olwehlayo lwe-ITIMU YEPHANELI lwalungaqhubeka lubonisa igama letimu endala
  ngemuva kokuba itimu ishintshile. Manje luhlala lubonisa itimu evuliwe.

AKUSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisense, ukwenza kusebenze nazo zonke izixhumanisi kusebenza njengakuqala
  nje.
- Amatimu e-Demon Slayer angu-11 abukeka ncamashi njengaku-2.2.8.
